name: Exp_FisherTransform_X2
summary: This EA uses the Fisher Transform indicator on two different timeframes to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the Fisher Transform crosses upward on both timeframes and short positions when it crosses downward. Exits are triggered by opposing crossover signals from the faster timeframe Fisher Transform.
summary_zh: 该EA使用两个不同周期的Fisher Transform指标来生成交易信号。当两个周期的Fisher Transform均向上交叉时做多，均向下交叉时做空。出场由较快周期的Fisher Transform反向交叉信号触发。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Fisher Transform指标的双周期确认信号系统。Fisher Transform是一种将价格概率分布转换为近似正态分布的指标，其核心优势在于产生清晰的买卖交叉信号，较少出现假信号。入场条件要求两个不同时间周期的Fisher Transform信号必须同向确认——快周期和慢周期均出现向上交叉时开多单，均出现向下交叉时开空单，这种多周期过滤机制有效减少了单一周期假信号导致的错误交易。出场条件依赖于快周期Fisher Transform的反向交叉信号，即持仓方向与快周期信号相反时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由用户通过参数设定，没有根据账户资金动态调整的机制。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但止损止盈的设定依赖于用户经验而非自适应算法。整体策略属于均值回归类，因为Fisher Transform在极端值区域产生的交叉信号本质上捕捉的是价格从超买超卖状态回归均值的运动。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a dual-timeframe confirmation signal system using the Fisher Transform indicator. The Fisher Transform converts price probability distributions into approximately Gaussian distributions, producing sharp crossover signals with fewer false triggers compared to traditional oscillators. Entry conditions require concurrent confirmation from both a fast and slow timeframe Fisher Transform — a long position is opened when both timeframes show an upward crossover, and a short position when both show a downward crossover. This multi-timeframe filtering mechanism significantly reduces erroneous trades caused by single-timeframe false signals. Exit conditions rely on the faster timeframe Fisher Transform generating an opposing crossover signal, closing positions when the fast-period signal reverses against the held position. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size specified by the user via input parameter, without any dynamic adjustment mechanism based on account equity or volatility. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but these depend on user experience rather than an adaptive algorithm. The overall strategy falls under mean reversion, as the Fisher Transform crossovers at extreme values inherently capture price movements returning from overbought or oversold states toward the mean.
pros: 双周期确认机制有效过滤假信号，提高入场质量
Fisher Transform指标产生的交叉信号清晰锐利，减少模糊判断
策略逻辑简洁明了，参数较少，易于理解和调优
多周期趋势过滤避免了逆势交易的风险
同时提供止损止盈机制，具备基本风险控制框架
pros_en: Dual-timeframe confirmation effectively filters false signals and improves entry quality
Fisher Transform produces sharp and clear crossover signals, reducing ambiguous judgment
Simple and transparent strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
Multi-timeframe trend filtering avoids the risk of counter-trend trading
Provides both stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms, establishing a basic risk control framework
cons: 固定手数无法根据市场波动或账户资金动态调整，资金利用效率低
止损止盈依赖人工设定，缺乏自适应机制，在剧烈行情中可能不够灵活
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差或低流动性时段可能产生不利成交
Fisher Transform在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
没有仓位检查和重复开仓保护机制，可能存在重复下单风险
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust based on market volatility or account equity, leading to inefficient capital utilization
Stop-loss and take-profit rely on manual configuration without adaptive mechanisms, potentially inflexible during volatile markets
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Fisher Transform tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
No position check or duplicate order protection mechanism, creating risk of repeated order placement
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理模块，根据ATR或账户风险比例自动调整手数
加入点差过滤、交易时段限制和新K线检查，减少不利条件下的交易
引入移动止损或保本止损机制，在盈利时锁定部分利润
增加Fisher Transform极端值区域的额外确认条件，减少震荡市假信号
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing module that automatically adjusts lot size based on ATR or account risk percentage
Implement spread filter, trading session restrictions, and new bar check to reduce trading under unfavorable conditions
Introduce trailing stop or breakeven mechanism to lock in partial profits when trades move favorably
Add extra confirmation conditions for Fisher Transform extreme value zones to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓
固定手数在高波动行情下风险敞口不可控
未对点差和滑点进行过滤保护
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions within the same candle
Fixed lot size leads to uncontrolled risk exposure during high volatility market conditions
No spread or slippage filter protection implemented
